title: Quinquefid
summary: QUIN'QUEFID, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and findo, to split.] In botany, five-cleft; cut into five segments with linear sinuses and straight margins; as a leaf.

inlines.v: QUIN'QUEFID, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and findo, to split.] In botany, five-cleft; cut into five segments with linear sinuses and straight margins; as a leaf.
